title: The Work of Keeping a Public Building Public: The Drill Hall in Johannesburg

Yet these conditions are not always secured through the act of building itself. They are continually negotiated, often through forms of work that remain outside the conventional understanding of architectural practice.

title: The Vineyard HOUSE? / Lauti Esain
summary: The Vineyard ?HOUSE? On September 10, 2022, at 12:29 p.m., I broke ground with the first of thousands of shovels I would dig to build my house. But the story began in my second year of architecture school, when I lost my parents. That was when I started working and saving, just in case something happened to me. Then, a dream emerged: to live on a vineyard. I decided that if I didn't need to use those savings upon graduating, I would use them to build my house. When I graduated, my savings were enough for 215 sq ft (20 m²), but by building it with my own hands, I could save on labor costs and reach 355 sq ft (33 m²).

title: House Around a Column / fala

title: Understory House / Gluck+

Located in a rural second-growth forest marked by miles of historic stone walls, the 3,170-square-foot house responds directly to the character and memory of the land.

title: Beyond Buildings: ArchDaily's November Editorial Focus
summary: "Design a cultural center on a desert coastline, in the style of Alvar Aalto, wood structure, golden hour, aerial drone shot, photorealistic, 4K." Within seconds, a line like this returns a convincing image. What is less visible is the shift it demands. For centuries, architectural imagination relied on the body: the hand that sketches, the fingers that shape a model, or, more recently, the click of a mouse in computational tools. Words came afterward, to explain what had already taken form. Today, the order is increasingly reversed. Before an image can exist, it must first be described: its references named, its materials listed, its mood specified.

summary: 清水建設が、現場内に資機材を搬入する車両や揚重設備の予約情報などをクラウド上で一元管理する「建設物流DXシステム」を開発した。資機材搬入に伴う協力会社の現場内移動や待機の時間と手間を減らす。

title: 鹿島、ダムの基礎処理工を自動化 常駐監視員ゼロ
